_meta.indication: SPINRAZA is indicated for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in pediatric and adult patients

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study CS3B, a Phase 3 sham-procedure controlled trial in infantile-onset SMA
pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed FDA documents
pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, sham-procedure controlled trial; approximately 111 subjects were to be randomized 2:1 to a scaled-equivalent 12 mg dose of nusinersen intrathecally or a sham procedure
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with infantile-onset SMA who have 2 copies of the SMN2 gene; males and females ≤ 7 months (210 days) of age at screening
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of motor milestone responders (based on Section 2 of the Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination)
pivotal_trials.n: 121 subjects in the ITT population received at least 1 dose (nusinersen n=80, sham control n=41) as of the June 15, 2016 interim analysis
pivotal_trials.result: A statistically significantly greater proportion achieved a motor milestone response in the nusinersen group (21; 41%) versus sham control (0; 0%), p < 0.0001

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20% and ≥5% more than control) were lower respiratory infection (43% vs 29%), upper respiratory infection (39% vs 34%), and constipation (30% vs 22%); serious atelectasis was more frequent (14% vs 5%). Warnings include thrombocytopenia/coagulation abnormalities and renal toxicity.
target_moa: Nusinersen is a survival motor neuron-2 (SMN2)-directed antisense oligonucleotide that binds a sequence in the intron downstream of exon 7 of the SMN2 transcript, increasing exon 7 inclusion in SMN2 mRNA and production of full-length SMN protein
modality: Oligonucleotide (18-mer antisense oligonucleotide with phosphorothioate backbone)

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues

description.text: Updated labeling with efficacy/safety data from controlled trials in infantile-onset and later-onset SMA and presymptomatic SMA, not a new indication.

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for changes to the labeling that were based on results from controlled clinical trials in infantile-onset spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and in later-onset SMA, as well as interim results from an open-label study in presymptomatic SMA. The revisions include changes to section 5 (Warnings and Precautions), section 6 (Adverse Reactions), section 12.2 (Pharmacodynamics), and section 14 (Clinical Studies) of the prescribing information (PI). In addition, this supplement provides for an update to section 2 (Dosage and Administration) to include language that the use of an external filter is not required, and the correction of the molecular structure of nusinersen in section 11 (Description) of the PI.

description.text: Added a higher dosing regimen with two new strength presentations (28 mg/5 mL and 50 mg/5 mL)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for revisions throughout the Prescribing Information (PI) regarding a completed clinical study [Study 4 (NCT04089566)], which provides an additional higher dosing regimen. Two corresponding additional strength presentations [28 mg/5 mL (5.6 mg/mL) and 50 mg/5 mL (10 mg/mL)] are included for administration of the new dosing regimen. This sNDA also includes revisions to the Pediatric Use subsection (8.4) of the PI to include results from a combined 6- and 13-week toxicity study in juvenile monkeys.
